create_aggregator: create an Aggregator instance with a PyTorch module and AggregationType to aggregate model deltas
add_update_to_aggregator: add a model delta update with a weight to the Aggregator buffer module
aggregate_model_deltas: call aggregate on the Aggregator to synchronize and return the aggregated buffer module
zero_aggregator_weights: zero out the Aggregator buffer module weights and sum of aggregation weights
apply_weight_to_delta: apply a weight to a model delta in-place using apply_weight_to_update
